# InsertTreeViewNode <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Tree Views](BlitzPlus-Tree-Views)

</div>


```blitzbasic
InsertTreeViewNode:Int32 index:Int32, text:String, parent_node:Int32, icon:Int32=-1
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `index` | In | Int32 | required | Where the node goes among the children, starting at 0. |
| `text` | In | String | required | Text of the node. |
| `parent_node` | In | Int32 | required | The node it goes into. |
| `icon` | In | Int32 | `-1` | Number of an icon of the tree. Defaults to -1, which means none. |

**Returns:** A handle for the new node.

## Description

Puts a node before the child with the given number of a parent.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win  = CreateWindow("Insert", 10, 10, 300, 200, Desktop(), 3)
tree = CreateTreeView(10, 10, 270, 140, win)
root = TreeViewRoot(tree)
AddTreeViewNode "First", root
AddTreeViewNode "Third", root
InsertTreeViewNode 1, "Second", root
Repeat
Until WaitEvent() = $803
```
